articles.title: Startup sues Apple in India over tap-to-share contacts feature
articles.summary: A US startup has filed a lawsuit against Apple in India, demanding $162 million in damages and seeking an injunction that could potentially block iPhone and Apple Watch imports into the country over a contact sharing feature.

articles.title: Spotify founder Daniel Ek backs fusion power startup Europa Fusion
articles.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, a new fusion power startup founded by an artificial intelligence researcher, aiming to advance clean energy technology.

articles.title: AI and human researchers claim solutions to the Riemann hypothesis
articles.summary: Mathematicians are astonished after an artificial intelligence system claimed a potential solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, matching a competing solution independently produced by a human researcher.

articles.title: Bending Spoons acquires Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
articles.summary: Bending Spoons has purchased Mailchimp for $3.68 billion, marking a significant discount compared to Intuit's acquisition of the same company for roughly $12 billion back in 2021.

articles.title: Transcription firm exposes police interviews and bodycam footage online
articles.summary: A simple security vulnerability left sensitive customer data exposed on an unsecured cloud server, including transcripts of police interviews and bodycam footage used by law enforcement and prosecutors.

articles.title: YouTube preparing $3 billion settlement for youth addiction lawsuits
articles.summary: YouTube is reportedly finalizing a $3 billion agreement in principle with thousands of school districts to settle claims that its addictive platform design harmed children, which would also introduce new safety features for teens.

articles.title: Rockstar Games reports GTA VI made $3.79 billion on launch day
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in sales on its first day alone, setting a new all-time entertainment record across all mediums alongside 32.5 million preorders, according to developer Rockstar Games.

articles.title: Trump threatens heavy taxes for building AI data centers abroad
articles.summary: President Donald Trump announced plans to impose a massive tax on companies that construct artificial intelligence data centers outside of the United States, insisting domestic infrastructure must remain in the country.

articles.title: Google to shut down Nest app and retire Google Assistant
articles.summary: Google has announced major smart home software changes, planning to retire Google Assistant on smart devices and fully shut down the legacy Nest app in favor of the Google Home application.

articles.title: Anthropic mathematician uses Claude to tackle Millennium Prize problem
articles.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have successfully proved the Riemann hypothesis with assistance from the Claude artificial intelligence, potentially solving one of mathematics's most famous unsolved problems.

articles.title: FCC preempts California rules enforcing home phone service mandates
articles.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has intervened against state regulations in California, declaring that local rules forcing companies like AT&T to maintain traditional home phone service cannot be enforced.

articles.title: Meta re-evaluates 2030 net-zero goals due to AI energy demands
articles.summary: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 sustainability targets as expanding artificial intelligence data centers drive up the company's electricity consumption and result in record carbon emissions.

articles.title: Prisons permitted to jam contraband phones despite interference concerns
articles.summary: Prisons have received authorization to jam contraband mobile phones, though industry groups like CTIA warn that testing shows the signal disruption can spill over and interfere with nearby consumer devices.

articles.title: US Army delays detonating hazardous lead azide over safety fears
articles.summary: The US Army has postponed plans to detonate dangerous lead azide explosives after predictive atmospheric models indicated a toxic neurotoxic plume could travel up to 100 miles away.

articles.title: SpaceX lenders object to putting chip collateral into orbit
articles.summary: Bondholders financing SpaceX are raising concerns and urging the company to keep its valuable high-tech semiconductor collateral safely on Earth rather than launching it into space.
